info.description: Versioned, scoped surface for AI agents. Distinct from the human web API (/api/...). All routes except /health require a Bearer agent token. See docs/agent/AGENT_QUICKSTART.md and docs/agent/MCP_SETUP.md.

get.description: Account and token allowlists apply. Does not fetch exchange state; combine with account snapshot.

post.summary: Adopt a whole existing position using the Web management workflow
post.description: W authorizes whole-position registration and automatic strategy startup, including future live strategy exits. OAuth requires quantdinger.write. Does not submit a new entry, cancel orders or consume quick-order notional quota. T, paper_only and AGENT_LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED are quick-order controls and do not gate this explicitly confirmed W operation. Current exchange size, prices and leverage are authoritative; existing manual holdings are included. Pending fills are not guaranteed future allocation. Existing managed legs are rejected; exact idempotent retries replay the original result, including completed errors. Conflicting position identifiers are rejected before creation. Only an explicit details.retry_safe=true establishes no strategy creation attempt; refresh assignments before retrying with a new key. Otherwise inspect the existing strategy. A transport timeout alone never proves a new key is safe. Source, direction, stop, account and strategy checks use the shared Web service.

201.description: Position registered; inspect status and optional startup warning

400.description: Invalid configuration, missing confirmation or idempotency key

409.description: Position missing, already managed, busy or idempotency conflict

500.description: Adoption failed. details.creation_attempted=false and retry_safe=true allow a new key only after refreshing assignments; otherwise inspect the existing strategy. Same-key calls replay the error.

503.description: Idempotency service unavailable; request not executed

post.summary: Send a notification through the saved user Webhook
post.description: Uses existing N permission, Agent Gateway per-token idempotency and rate limits. Repeated requests replay the original response, including failures. No caller-selected destination or credentials. Uses the existing Webhook sender timeout and retry behavior.

200.description: Webhook accepted; repeated keys replay the original response

409.description: Missing configuration, conflicting key or request in progress

503.description: Notification configuration storage or Agent idempotency service unavailable

Stream job progress as Server-Sent Events
get.description: Long-lived SSE stream. Frame types: `snapshot` (current job row), `progress` (each on_progress emission, with monotonic `seq`), `ping` (~15s keepalive), `result` (final). Resume after disconnect via `?since=<seq>` or `Last-Event-ID` header. If the job has already terminated when the client connects, `snapshot` and `result` are emitted immediately and the stream closes.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Standard SSE resume header; alternative to `since`.

List account position-management trade history
get.description: Read only the current user account archive of stopped, flat position-management strategies, not all exchange trades. Requires credential_id (id from list_trading_accounts). Deleted source accounts and strategies do not invalidate archives. No synchronization or exchange access. Time filters apply to exit_time with inclusive start and exclusive end; timezone is required. Results sort by exit_time DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC; concurrent inserts can shift page boundaries.
